description: Verify that DUT silently discards a DHCPOFFER whose 'xid' does not match the originating DISCOVER's xid — DUT must NOT emit a DHCPREQUEST in response (RFC 2131 §4.4.1 MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
The transaction id (xid) ties an OFFER to the DISCOVER it answers. If a server replies with a different xid, that OFFER belongs to someone else's transaction — accepting it would let an attacker hijack the binding. DUT must drop and not REQUEST.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → wire: DHCPDISCOVER (xid = X)
2. Tester → DUT: DHCPOFFER (xid = X+1, deliberately mismatched)

3. Observation:
   • DUT must NOT emit a DHCPREQUEST in response   ← key check

[Pass condition]
No DHCPREQUEST follows the mismatched-xid OFFER within the listen window.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_unexpected_request — DUT emitted REQUEST after the mismatched-xid OFFER (xid validation absent)
• Fail_no_discover — DUT did not emit DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT discarded the mismatched-xid OFFER and did not REQUEST — normal
verdicts.Fail_unexpected_request: DUT emitted DHCPREQUEST after a mismatched-xid OFFER
verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
